# SupoClip Pattern Adoption

Read `docs/13-SUPOCLIP-RESEARCH.md` and `docs/14-LICENSING-AND-THIRD-PARTY.md`. Evaluate quick task creation, async worker pipeline, SSE progress, source maps, multi-track editor, immutable drafts, typed AI edit operations with undo, optional fail-soft B-roll, platform presets and performance feedback. Adopt concepts only unless explicit licence review authorizes code use. Do not switch ARQ/Celery or ORM strategy without an approved ADR.
